_설명: 게임 그림 목록. key는 파일 이름, emoji는 게임에서 이 그림으로 바꿔 그릴 이모지(없으면 코드에서 key로 씀). kind: sprite(투명 캐릭터·소품) / ui(투명 버튼) / bg(배경). ref는 그림체·생김새를 맞출 때 참고할 그림. size는 생성 크기. flop: true면 좌우를 뒤집어요(게임은 캐릭터가 왼쪽을 본다고 가정)

style.sprite: Style: cute handmade 3D clay figure for a preschool picture book app, plasticine texture with subtle fingerprints, soft rounded shapes, warm soft studio lighting, gentle pastel colors. One single object, centered, whole object visible with generous empty margin, no ground, no cast shadow, no text, isolated on a fully transparent background.
style.ui: Style: chunky glossy 3D clay game button for a preschool app, soft rounded shapes, plasticine texture, soft studio lighting, pastel colors. Single button centered with empty margin, no text or letters, no shadow on the ground, isolated on a fully transparent background.
style.bg: Style: handmade 3D clay diorama background for a preschool picture book app, plasticine texture, soft rounded shapes, warm soft lighting, gentle pastel colors, shallow depth of field. Wide landscape view, no characters, no animals, no text. Keep the center and lower middle open and uncluttered so characters can stand there.
